# Bundled KaTeX

Version: 0.18.7. MIT license; see LICENSE.
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.18.7.tgz
Upstream: https://katex.org/docs/api

katex.min.js is copied unchanged from the package's dist directory.
PanoLearn requests MathML output, rendered natively by Chrome 111+.
No CDN requests, external fonts, or remote scripts are required at runtime.
